title: Night Ferry
logline: On the last ferry across the Bosphorus, an old Istanbul tea seller helps a young Japanese backpacker who has lost her passport, and the two strangers search the boat together as the city lights slide past.
style: Warm, gentle night drama, sodium orange and teal city lights reflected on dark water, tulip tea glasses glowing amber, soft film grain, steady handheld camera, realistic 35mm film look.

HASAN.desc: a Turkish man in his late sixties with a thick white moustache, short white hair and a lined friendly face, wearing a plain white short-sleeved shirt, a dark brown waistcoat, dark grey trousers and black leather shoes

YUKI.desc: a Japanese woman of about twenty-four with a black bob haircut and dark eyes, wearing a plain olive green rain jacket, a plain grey hoodie underneath, black jeans, white trainers and a large plain blue backpack

DECK.desc: the open rear deck of an old white Istanbul passenger ferry at night, with wooden benches, railings and the lit city skyline across the dark Bosphorus
DECK.prompt: The open rear deck of an old white Istanbul passenger ferry at night: rows of slatted wooden benches, white painted railings, a red Turkish flag at the stern, the lit mosques and bridges of Istanbul across the dark Bosphorus water, clear night sky, no people, static wide shot, realistic photography.

TRAY.desc: a round silver-coloured metal serving tray hanging from three chains joined at a ring handle, carrying small tulip-shaped glasses of dark red tea on saucers
TRAY.role: his round hanging tea tray with small tulip glasses of tea

PASSPORT.desc: a dark red Japanese passport booklet with a gold chrysanthemum emblem on the cover

shots.prompt: YUKI stands at the railing of the rear deck taking a photo of the lit city with her phone, smiling, her backpack on her shoulders. Medium shot, city lights behind her. Audio: wind, water, a camera shutter click.
HASAN steps out onto the deck with TRAY, sees the young woman kneeling among her scattered things, and slows down. Medium shot. Audio: the door creaking, wind.

HASAN sets a glass of tea on the bench beside YUKI and crouches down. Medium two-shot. Audio: he says in Turkish "Bir şey mi kaybettin, kızım?", she answers in English "My passport. My flight is tomorrow.".
HASAN dives forward onto his knees and grabs PASSPORT just as the wind lifts it, holding it up triumphantly. Medium shot. Audio: a thump, his laugh, the wind gusting.
